links.outcome: Change in recall and hallucination rate after long-text modeling for Qwen 2.5
links.effect: LTM raised recall by 0.1119 ± 0.2000 (P < 0.05) and lowered hallucination rate by 0.2985 ± 0.4220 (P < 0.05).
links.quote: Long-text modeling (LTM) significantly enhanced recall by 0.1119 ± 0.2000 (P < 0.05) and reduced hallucination rate by 0.2985 ± 0.4220 (P < 0.05).

unlisted_practices: Chain-of-thought prompting to improve LLM accuracy (recall up, hallucination increase not significant)

screen.practice: long-text context grounding and chain-of-thought prompting
screen.reason: Evaluates Chinese LLMs on dental implantology benchmark questions and compares hallucination and recall metrics with and without prompt/context strategies (chain-of-thought and long-text modeling).

primary.practice: chain-of-thought prompting and long-text modeling enhancement
